title: GPOM Second Half C: The Walk Out
heading: GitPush Origin Master ▲ second half C: the walk out
about: After the vote (Kai writes it; all hundred agreed). Maddie leads the hundred out of the bunker and across the downs to the AI's building. Stage 1 written brief: brief.md; music: music.md.
stage: 1 (written brief, no interview: the 2026-10-21 autonomous run, second-half-ending-goal.md)

maddie.rule: ALWAYS this reference; the torn bunting stays in every shot
maddie.voice: Gemini TTS Aoede (Bristol, the plan's bot profile)

ai.rule: No body, ever. Speaks through Maddie's speaker (beacon pulses on his words); the last line of the film is the one unfiltered read
ai.voice: Suno Voice "badcode newsreader" (the AI), dry, through Maddie's speaker: small-speaker filter, beacon pulses on his words

building.rule: ONE fixed design: a long, low building of black glass, many times longer than it is tall, with one single thin horizontal seam of warm amber light running its whole length, set down in a fold between two green chalk downs, the only made thing in sight; no windows, no signs, no other lights
building.note: Design anchor = the BL series (BL1-day, BL2-dusk, BL4-seam-opens, BL5-aerial; second-half-moodboard.md). L11-exterior-night is NOT this design (a tall near-cubic block, seam part-way) and is not used.

beats.name: Off the step
beats.blurb: They have only just agreed to leave and they do not trust her yet. From inside the dark bunker, past the hundred's wary backs and faces (the old lady among them, silent), Maddie waits alone on the step in the daylight doorway, turned back to them. Nobody moves. She coaxes. Then the first one or two edge out into the light.

lines.speaker: maddie
lines.voice: Gemini TTS Aoede (Bristol, the plan's bot profile)
lines.text: Go on. I promise you'll be okay.
lines.how: coaxing, gentle, sincere; to people who are frightened of her, not hurrying them

lines.speaker: maddie
lines.voice: Gemini TTS Aoede (Bristol, the plan's bot profile)
lines.how: gentle, sincere, a promise she means; quieter, after a beat
lines.note: a beat after the line before; placed in the edit, voiced separately

beats.name: Into daylight
beats.blurb: The hundred file out of the hill, blinking. Maddie's joke gets them over the threshold. The kill bots' track marks are still gouged in the grass.

lines.speaker: maddie
lines.voice: Gemini TTS Aoede (Bristol, the plan's bot profile)
lines.how: light, a little too cheerful, encouraging them out as they squint at the sky
lines.note: Kai's words ('please go careful, humans'), Claude's wording, agreed in replies.lc1-1

lines.speaker: maddie
lines.voice: Gemini TTS Aoede (Bristol, the plan's bot profile)
lines.text: I'm fairly sure there's no radiation round here.
lines.how: light, a little too cheerful; a tiny hesitation before 'fairly', which is the joke
lines.note: the ~0.6 s beat after 'Careful now, humans.' is placed in the edit; voiced separately

beats.name: The long walk
beats.blurb: One unbroken travelling shot: the camera backs along the chalk track and Maddie rolls after it, as on the high street in beat 0, but now a hundred people walk behind her.

beats.name: The seat
beats.blurb: Sandra and Derek, walking. The row, one last time, and what it now means: nobody is coming back, and she is still right.

lines.speaker: sandra
lines.text: I hope you put that bloody seat down.
lines.how: brisk, sideways, as if it is any other morning

lines.speaker: derek
lines.text: Doesn't bloody matter now, love. We're not coming back, are we?
lines.how: weary, gentle, not looking at her; the second sentence quieter, the cost said plainly

lines.speaker: sandra
lines.text: It does matter. In ten thousand years, when the aliens dig up that bunker, they'll know it was you.
lines.how: deadpan, certain, completely serious; lands on 'you'
lines.note: Kai's joke (bc4), Claude's wording, Kai picked option (a) (answers_round1.Q1)

beats.after: Derek: no line. A look (on C05).

beats.name: Over the brow
beats.blurb: From behind the hundred at the crest: the AI's building in the fold of the downs below. They stop.

lines.speaker: derek
lines.text: Bloody hell. Look at that building.

lines.speaker: maddie
lines.voice: Gemini TTS Aoede (Bristol, the plan's bot profile)
lines.text: Yeah. He's been working on this one for quite a long time.
lines.how: proud, fond, of her boss; a little understated
lines.note: Kai's words (lc5-1), Claude's wording; assumes the vote scene has told them the time machine is in there

beats.name: Mind the step
beats.blurb: At the building: the amber seam has opened into a doorway with one low step. Maddie stops at it and asks them in, a host at her boss's door. The boss does not speak in scene C: it is her scene.

lines.speaker: maddie
lines.voice: Gemini TTS Aoede (Bristol, the plan's bot profile)
lines.how: warm host at the door; welcoming, a little proud

frames.purpose: The turn of the scene: they do not trust her yet. From inside the dark bunker, past the hundred's wary backs and faces, Maddie alone on the step in the daylight, turned back to them, coaxing. Nobody moves.

still.prompt: Using the first image for the robot, the second for the old woman and the third for the bunker: a low shot from inside the dark bunker corridor, looking out past the backs, shoulders and half-turned wary faces of survivors in worn jumpers, coats and woolly hats crowded in the shadow, towards the open green steel blast doors and the grey daylight beyond. Among the faces, to one side and lit by the doorway, the old woman from the second image, the same face, grey hair in a bun, glasses and green cable-knit cardigan, silent and unconvinced. Alone on the concrete step in the bright doorway, small, the small grey six-wheeled delivery robot from the first image, its amber beacon lit softly and the torn, faded cloth bunting hanging across its front wheels, turned back to face the people inside. Nobody has moved. Overcast grey daylight outside, deep shadow inside, muted greens and greys, cinematic, fine film grain. 16:9 frame from a fictional near-future British film. Full-frame image, no captions, logos, lettering or on-screen text.
